name: AES
rootCause: AES was reported as a BNB Chain incident on 2022-12-07 with a reported loss of $61,608. The located public evidence is limited to a single hack-catalogue record that classifies the case as a token and share accounting rounding error, with no transaction hash, contract address, or postmortem found. The exact failing operation is not independently established. The only located incident-specific record is a public hack-catalogue entry that classifies AES as a token and share accounting incident caused by a rounding error.
